appDescription: A local vehicle observation and driver concern journal with explicit handover and inspection records.

function.name: QUERY_CARITDA_CONTEXT
function.description: Opens a local preview of recorded concerns, handover notes, received vehicle values or tire data availability. User confirmation is required before reading stored content.

topic.description: The requested kind of local vehicle context.

function.name: DRAFT_CARITDA_ISSUE
function.description: Prepares text for a driver concern. The user must choose the recording person, review the draft and explicitly save. Does not diagnose or request an AI explanation.

situation.description: The symptoms stated by the user without invented details.
